name: Marketplace
title: Templates/Platform/View/Marketplace
summary: The marketplace page: a medium page heading with the outlined Documentation action over `Tabs` for Integrations and Templates. The Integrations tab shows a Featured row of three integration cards while no filter is set, then All integrations: one `PropertyFilter` (free text over name, publisher and description; Publisher, Category, Context and Status as properties, all in the URL through `useCollection`) over a grid of `Card kind="integration"` tiles with the logo, the name, by the publisher, two lines of description, the category badge, the Installed tag and an Install or Configure action. A tile opens the integration in a medium right `Drawer`: name and publisher in the header, the description, `KeyValuePairs` (publisher, category, context, version, last update, the applications it runs on), an Overview in `DocProse`, the permissions it needs, and the install form, a required Application `Field` with a `Select` of the applications it is not on yet. Install is an async run (`platform/states/async-submit`): the button shows `loading`, a progress toast follows the user, and the outcome lands as a toast and an inline `Alert` in the drawer; success carries Configure and Open application, failure is permanent and carries Edit and Reinstall. The Templates tab shows popular templates and links to the template browser. A search that matches nothing shows No matching integrations with Clear filters; while the catalog loads the tiles are skeletons.

variants.name: Templates
variants.summary: The Templates tab: popular templates as tiles that open in the template browser, with Browse all templates.

variants.name: Detail
variants.summary: The detail drawer open on Request Signer: details, overview, permissions and the install form.

variants.name: Installing
variants.summary: Install is running on storefront: the button shows loading, the field is disabled and the progress toast says it keeps running if the panel closes.

variants.name: Installed
variants.summary: The install succeeded: the success Alert in the drawer, the Installed tag on the tile, Configure in the footer and the success toast with Configure and Open application.

variants.name: InstallFailed
variants.summary: The install failed on checkout: the danger Alert with the reason and Reinstall, and the permanent failure toast with Edit and Reinstall.

variants.name: NoMatch
variants.summary: A search that matches no integration: the Featured row hides, the token stays and a medium EmptyState offers Clear filters.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The catalog is loading: the filter is disabled and skeleton tiles hold the grid.

variants.name: SolutionPage
variants.summary: The integration as a full page (Waiting Room): a Back to Marketplace `Link`, the `PageHeader`, `Tabs` for Overview, Usage, Changelog (version history, Latest marked) and Applications (a `Table` of the applications running it, `Table.CellStatus` Up to date or Update available and an Update to <version> action), beside an install card whose Application `Select` tags each application Installed or Update available. Install and Update are async runs that end in a toast with Configure and Open application.

variants.name: Configure
variants.summary: The screen behind Configure: the integration's settings on one application (Queue visitors `Switch`, Capacity and Queue page title fields, Session length `Select`) in `SettingsSection`s, errors after Save with a summary `Alert`, and a `SaveBar` with Discard and Save; saving is not a deploy, so its toast has no Redeploy.

variants.name: TemplatePage
variants.summary: A template as a full page (Nuxt Storefront): a Back to Templates `Link`, the description, the deploy form (application name and repository, errors after Deploy) beside the template facts; Deploy is an async run that ends in the async-submit toast with Edit and Redeploy.
